notes: THE KIT. Every thing a Granadad docker could own, one row each. No fantasy loot.
drams is weight; the base sheet carries 240 of them (loadCapDrams). royals is worth.
slot is where it is worn: hand / body / head / feet / trinket / none.
class is the brawl line's own word (brawl.hpp Weapon): fists, improvised, blunt, evictor, edged.
damage on a hand item is the CLASS's span and is checked at load; write it for the reader, never to change a roll.
dr is flat damage reduction while worn. heat is what the Watch adds per unit when it finds it on you.
contraband names the sack good a row is the face for; its count is the sack's, never the Kit's.
stands put a thing on a tile before anybody moves it; owned means taking it is theft (THEIRS on the crosshair).
carried is what a roster body has on it when it dies: by name first, then by role.

items.name: CUDGEL
items.desc: OAK, HANDLE-WORN. EVERY HOUSE KEEPS ONE UNDER THE BAR.

items.name: THE EVICTOR
items.desc: A HEADED CUDGEL MADE FOR PUTTING A MAN OUT, NOT OPEN. THE FLAME'S OWN GIFT.

items.name: MACE
items.desc: AN IRON HEAD ON AN ASH HAFT. A WATCHMAN'S WHOLE ARGUMENT.

items.name: BOTTLE
items.desc: CORKED AND HALF FULL. SWUNG, IT IS SOMETHING.

items.name: KNIFE
items.desc: A GUTTING KNIFE OFF THE STRAND. EVERY DOCKER OWNS ONE. IT IS NOT A BRAWL WEAPON.

items.name: DAGGER
items.desc: A HAND'S LENGTH OF STEEL WITH A GUARD ON IT. THE ROOFS CARRY THESE.

items.name: CUTLASS
items.desc: SHORT AND HEAVY. THE KESTREL'S CREW WEAR THEM ASHORE AND THE WATCH LETS IT GO.

items.name: BOAT-HOOK
items.desc: AN IRON HOOK ON A POLE. THE QUAY'S OWN TOOL, AND IT OPENS A MAN LIKE ONE.

items.name: COAT
items.desc: OILED WOOL, HEAVY WITH RAIN. IT TURNS THE WEATHER AND A LITTLE ELSE.

items.name: HOOD
items.desc: TARRED CANVAS OVER THE EARS. WHO YOU ARE STAYS UNDER IT.

items.name: BOOTS
items.desc: SEA BOOTS, NEVER QUITE DRY. THE QUAY EATS SHOE LEATHER.

items.name: PURSE
items.desc: LEATHER, DRAWSTRING. WHAT A CUTPURSE IS AFTER. THE COIN IS COIN AND WEIGHS NOTHING.

items.name: LANTERN
items.desc: HORN-PANED, HALF A CANDLE IN IT. THE DOCKS GO DARK EARLY.

items.name: ROPE
items.desc: TEN FATHOMS OF TARRED LINE. HEAVY, AND ALWAYS WANTED BY SOMEBODY.

items.name: PICKS
items.desc: A BENT WIRE AND A TENSION BAR. FINCH SELLS THEM BY THE SET AND ASKS NOTHING.

items.name: LETTER
items.desc: FOLDED PAPER. SOMEBODY'S BUSINESS, AND NOW YOURS.

items.name: BALE
items.desc: THREE OF SOMETHING SEWN INTO SACKING. THE SNUG'S OWN, UNTIL IT IS ON YOUR SHOULDER.

items.name: STRONGBOX
items.desc: IRON-STRAPPED, AT THE BED FOOT. IT DOES NOT TRAVEL. WHAT IS IN IT MIGHT.

items.name: SCALP
items.desc: A RAT'S, TAKEN FOR THE WARD'S BOUNTY. THE FLAME SIGNS FOR IT OR NOBODY PAYS.

items.name: DUST
items.desc: A TWIST OF WHAT COMES OFF A BOAT AND IS NEVER ON THE MANIFEST.

items.name: QUAYFIRE
items.desc: A JAR OF SPIRIT THAT NEVER PASSED THE WEIGHHOUSE. A WATCHMAN CAN SEE A JAR.

items.name: FLOWER
items.desc: THE WARD'S SMOKE, DRIED AND PRESSED. EVERYBODY KNOWS THE SMELL.

items.name: PIECE
items.desc: A PIECE WITH SOMEBODY'S NAME ON IT. IMPOSSIBLE TO EXPLAIN AND WORTH THREE BALES.
